_comment: Smoke config: **real agent**, fake tasks. Proves the worker -> runner -> claude -> measure -> KEEP/revert -> verify -> finalize chain holds under real sessions. The fake tasks are CPU-only frozen harnesses (tests/make_fake_tasks.py), so no GPU is occupied; it does spend a small number of tokens. Point TASKS_DIR at them from the command line.

target._note_enforce: Smoke config: the tasks are CPU-only fakes from tests/make_fake_tasks.py, so there is no serving stack to declare and nothing for the naming gate to check. Any config that does target a real stack must fill in target.model instead.
